summary_1line: Palace attendants arrive to awaken the king with music and ritual, only to discover he has died, plunging the palace into grief.

image_candidates.scene_text: At dawn musicians and bards fill the palace halls with song while servants wait with golden pitchers of scented water for the king to awaken.
Attendant women gently touch the king's body and recoil in terror as they realize he no longer breathes.
Queen Kaushalya and Sumitra lie pale and motionless in grief, like dim stars hidden behind dark clouds.
